detection_candidates.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
detection_candidates.rationale: high — cmd.exe/batch execution with anomalous parents (Office, script hosts) is visible in process-creation logs

detection_candidates.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Visual Basic
detection_candidates.rationale: high — wscript/cscript executing VBS, especially spawned by Office, is a strong detectable signal

detection_candidates.technique_name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
detection_candidates.rationale: high — service creation (Event ID 7045 / 4697) and remote service install are strongly detectable
medium — credential-store access detectable mainly through known-tool (LaZagne) execution signatures

detection_candidates.technique_name: Disable or Modify System Firewall: Windows Host Firewall

detection_candidates.technique_name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol: Exfiltration Over Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol

high — remote downloads via certutil/PowerShell/bitsadmin and unexpected inbound file writes are strongly detectable in process + network telemetry

detection_candidates.technique_name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — legit-looking names (Adobe.exe) in non-standard paths (\ProgramData) are detectable via path/name baselining and signature mismatch

detection_candidates.technique_name: Modify Authentication Process: Password Filter DLL

detection_candidates.technique_name: Office Application Startup: Outlook Home Page

high — LaZagne execution and LSA-secret registry access are detectable via process and registry telemetry
